title: PlastiCogMDD: Assessment of plasticity and cognitive performance in patients with depression under various treatment modalities
summary: Use of the Neulogiq platform (plasticity measurement, cognitive parameters, EEG assessment) before and after clinically indicated esketamine treatment vs. without esketamine treatment.

interventions.name: The aim of the study is to investigate changes in visually evoked potential (VEP) modulation in patients with therapy-resistant major depressive disorder (MDD) before, during and after treatment with esketamine, and to compare them with patients not receiving esketamine during the observation time f

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Clinical diagnosis of therapy resistant MDD
• Capacity to consent
• In the investigator’s opinion, willing and able (physically and mentally) to participate in the study and comply with the visit schedule and other study requirements
• Clinical indication for esketamine treatment as defined by the esketamine (Spravato®) label (therapy-resistant depression, concomitant SSRI or SNRI treatment)
Exclusion criteria:
• Bipolar disorder, Schizophrenia
• Contraindications for esketamin treatment
• A medical condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would interfere with study participation or results, including but not limited to:
o Epilepsy
o Brain tumor
